convert_kakao_brain_unclip: convert Kakao Brain unCLIP model checkpoints to diffusers format and save as UnCLIPPipeline
convert_prior_checkpoint: convert a Kakao Brain prior transformer checkpoint to diffusers PriorTransformer format
convert_decoder_checkpoint: convert a Kakao Brain decoder checkpoint to diffusers UNet2DConditionModel and text projection format

convert_resnet_block: convert a Kakao Brain resnet block checkpoint weights to diffusers resnet checkpoint format
